title: BIG Badass Blueprint (BBB)
author: Desmond  D.
desc:
The purpose of this program is to push the body and mind past conventional limits using strategic overtraining principles, high volume, and relentless progression. It’s designed to maximize hypertrophy, density, and mental toughness by forcing adaptation where others quit.

This isn’t a plan for casual gym-goers — it’s built for the rare individuals who are serious about manifesting their best physique and are willing to embrace intensity, discipline, and discomfort to do so.

ss.note: 5th-7th Set FATALITY!!
10 reps close + 10 reps wide. 2 plates, 3 plates, 4 plates, 2 plates.
EZ curl bar.
Start with fairly heavy weight. Last set strict and controlled.

115lbs 2nd set.
180lbs 3rd set.

115lbs 5th set.
90lbs 6th set.

ss.note: Increase weight by two pins each set.
